auto_context.card: This is an archived birthday celebration 3D live concert stream for Omaru Polka (尾丸ポルカ), a VTuber from hololive Gamers under COVER Corp., uploaded on January 30, 2026. The stream features Polka performing a setlist of roughly fifteen songs in 3D, including covers such as ETERNAL BLAZE, ダイアモンド・クレバス, LOVEマシーン, and トライアングル・ドリーマー, as well as her new original song STARTING OVER, with MC segments in between. Live guests appearing in the concert include fellow hololive members AZKi, Nakiri Ayame, Ookami Mio, Shiranui Flare, Houshou Marine, Takane Lui, Kazama Iroha, Momosuzu Nene, Yukihana Lamy, and Shishiro Botan, among others. The tone throughout is celebratory, energetic, and casual, consistent with a fan-facing idol-style birthday live event; Japanese is the primary language, and hololive-specific terminology, member names, and song titles should be preserved carefully.
